name: Button
purpose: Starts an action: submits a form or runs a command on the page.
whenToUse: An action that changes something on this page

whenNotToUse.case: Several actions of equal weight side by side
whenNotToUse.instead: Button with variant secondary for all but one

states.how: data-pending and aria-disabled="true", via setPending or enhanceForm

props.name: variant
props.does: primary uses the theme's action colour; accent the theme's accent; secondary is outlined

props.name: pending
props.does: Marks the button as waiting; it stays focusable and keeps its label

props.name: render
props.does: Puts the button's props on another element, such as a router link

accessibility.web: Native <button>. A pending button uses aria-disabled, not disabled, so it stays in the tab order and screen readers say why nothing happens.
accessibility.ios: SwiftUI Button; pending maps to .disabled with an accessibility hint
accessibility.android: Compose Button; pending maps to enabled = false with stateDescription

content: A verb first, one to three words, sentence case: Send message, Save changes. Never OK or Submit.
